_comment: Example for an EdgeTX radio in USB joystick mode (classic mode: Ch1-8 -> axes). Find the real axis names and ranges with: evtest /dev/input/eventN. Axis names are python-evdev ecodes (ABS_X, ABS_Y, ABS_Z, ABS_RX, ...). Axes with 'center' are bipolar (deadband = fraction of half-travel); without 'center' they map linearly min..max -> 1000..2000. UNVERIFIED on a real TX12: the numbers are placeholders.
